name: lemma-telepath
description: Connect your Telegram to ZCode: search your chat archive, read the documents, photos and transcribed voice inside it, and reply as yourself — through a hosted MCP server.

description_i18n.en: Connect your Telegram to ZCode: search your chat archive, read the documents, photos and transcribed voice inside it, and reply as yourself — through a hosted MCP server.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将你的 Telegram 接入 ZCode：全文检索聊天归档，读取其中的文档、图片与语音转写，并以你本人的身份回复——通过托管的 MCP 服务器。
